queries.title: Total revenue (all order lines)
queries.sql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(Sales), 0), 2) AS total_revenue FROM Order_Items

queries.title: Order count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM Orders

queries.title: Revenue by region
queries.sql: SELECT l.Region AS region, ROUND(SUM(oi.Sales), 2) AS revenue FROM Order_Items oi JOIN Orders o ON oi.Order_ID = o.Order_ID JOIN Locations l ON o.Location_ID = l.Location_ID GROUP BY l.Region ORDER BY revenue DESC
